verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST API (with OpenAPI spec published at cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json) for launching and managing instances programmatically, including cloud-init configuration, base image selection, and webhook notifications — a genuine documented public API. Community evidence even shows a third party built an unofficial CLI/MCP server on top of it for AI agents, corroborating real-world usability. Missing for 10: official llms.txt/first-party AI-agent SDK, and the docs.lambda.ai discovery endpoints returned 404 in probes.
